narrative.intro: Fluor Intercontinental has $279M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Fluor Intercontinental won 13 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $21.5M, and obligations are up 89.2% year over year. Fluor Intercontinental’s work this year is concentrated in Facilities Support Services, which accounts for $279M in obligations. Fluor Intercontinental also shows obligations in Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) at $500 and in All Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services at $0. Fluor Intercontinental’s multi-year pattern shows prior fiscal-year obligations of $286M in FY21, $313M in FY22, $34.6M in FY23, $142M in FY24, and $148M in FY25, then the current FY26 total of $279M. Fluor Intercontinental’s current-year totals are partial, so these figures represent fiscal year to date obligations rather than full fiscal-year totals. This profile highlights where Fluor Intercontinental captured federal spending through the current fiscal period and how that compares to recent years.

sections.heading: How has Fluor Intercontinental’s federal business changed year over year?
sections.body: Fluor Intercontinental’s obligations are up 89.2% year over year. Fluor Intercontinental recorded $279M in FY26 to date, after posting $148M in FY25 and $142M in FY24. Fluor Intercontinental’s FY23 obligations were $34.6M, while FY22 and FY21 were $313M and $286M respectively.
